o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *kāp (“bowl, cup”); cognate with Karakhanid قابْ (qāp), Turkish kap, Turkmen gap (“box, bag”), Tatar кап (qap, “box, bag, case”).
From Proto-Turkic. Cognate with Turkish süpürmek, Chuvash шӑпӑр (šăp̬ăr, “broom”).
From Russian хозя́ин (xozjáin). Likely ultimately from Persian خواجه, in which case a doublet of qoca and xoca.
